title: Claude Managed Agents
content:
## Overview

Claude Managed Agents is Anthropic's platform for building and deploying cloud-hosted AI agents at scale. Rather than maintaining your own orchestration loop against the Claude API, Managed Agents provides infrastructure, memory, evaluation, and multi-agent coordination as managed services accessible through the Claude Platform (`platform.claude.com`).

As of mid-2026, Managed Agents includes five core capabilities: Memory, Dreaming, Outcomes, Multiagent Orchestration, and MCP Tunnels.

---

## Memory

Agents can read from and write to persistent **memory stores** — key-value data that survives across sessions. Memory allows an agent to accumulate knowledge about users, projects, and preferences over time, similar to how a long-tenured employee builds institutional knowledge.

Memory is structured into named stores scoped to a user, a project, or an organization. Agents read relevant memory at session start and write new facts or corrections as they surface during a task.

---

## Dreaming (Research Preview)

Announced at Code with Claude 2026 (May 6, 2026), **Dreaming** is a scheduled background process that reviews an agent's accumulated session history and memory stores, extracts useful patterns, and curates memory — removing noise and promoting reliable signals.

Key behaviors Dreaming surfaces:
- **Recurring mistakes** the agent makes across sessions, so they can be corrected
- **Convergent workflows** — sequences of tool calls agents repeatedly converge on for certain task types
- **Team-wide preferences** shared across users in an organization

Dreaming runs on a configurable schedule (nightly by default) and does not consume real-time session compute.

**Early results:** Legal-AI company Harvey ran the pilot program and reported task completion rates approximately **six times higher** after enabling Dreaming.

---

## Outcomes (Public Beta)

**Outcomes** adds a structured grader to the agent loop. You write a rubric describing what success looks like for a given task type, and after the agent produces output, a separate grader agent evaluates it against that rubric — in its own context window, isolated from the main agent's reasoning to prevent self-grading bias.

The grader scores the output, flags failures, and can trigger a retry with corrective feedback injected into the next attempt.

**Early results:** Medical document review company Wisedocs reported a **50% reduction in document review time** after combining Dreaming and Outcomes.

---

## Multiagent Orchestration (Public Beta)

For tasks too large or complex for a single agent, **Multiagent Orchestration** lets a **lead agent** decompose work and delegate pieces to specialist **subagents**. Each subagent has:

- Its own model selection (e.g., Haiku for fast drafting, Opus for complex reasoning)
- Its own system prompt and tool set
- Read/write access to a **shared filesystem** visible to all participants

Subagents execute in parallel. The lead agent monitors progress, merges results, and handles failures.

This is the platform-managed version of the subagent patterns described in the raw API — infrastructure managed by Anthropic rather than the developer.

---

## MCP Tunnels & Self-Hosted Sandboxes (May 2026)

Two additional features were added to Managed Agents in May 2026:

**MCP Tunnels:** Allows a Managed Agent to reach MCP servers running inside a private network (behind a firewall or VPN) without exposing them to the public internet. The tunnel is established via a lightweight agent-side proxy authenticated with organization-scoped keys.

**Self-Hosted Sandboxes:** Instead of Anthropic's managed code execution environment, teams can point Managed Agents at their own sandboxed execution environment (a Kubernetes namespace, Firecracker VM fleet, etc.). Useful for organizations with data residency requirements or custom runtime dependencies.

---

## Platform Access & Pricing

Managed Agents features are available at `platform.claude.com`:

| Feature | Status |
|---|---|
| Memory | Generally Available |
| Outcomes | Public Beta |
| Multiagent Orchestration | Public Beta |
| MCP Tunnels | Public Beta |
| Self-Hosted Sandboxes | Public Beta |
| Dreaming | Research Preview (invite-based) |

Pricing is consumption-based: billed per session, per memory operation, and per Dreaming run — separate from model token costs.
